item.title: XPeng Extends Self-Developed Turing AI Chip From EVs Into Humanoids
item.description: XPeng is pushing its self-developed Turing AI silicon beyond intelligent EVs into humanoid robots as part of a Physical AI stack, with IRON configurations cited at about three on-device Turing chips totaling roughly 2,250 TOPS.

item.title: Boyagongdao Shows BG-5 Biomimetic Robotic Fish for Shallow Inspection at CIFTIS
item.description: Boyagongdao displayed its BG-5 Golden Dragon Fish biomimetic AUV at CIFTIS — about 3 kg and 640 mm long, with a soft multi-joint tail, 0.6 m/s top speed and a 5-meter depth rating for propeller-free shallow inspection.

item.title: Blueworm Embodied Launches Mantis Standard Modular Wheeled Humanoid From RMB 9,800
item.description: Blueworm Embodied introduced Mantis Standard, a modular wheeled humanoid starting at RMB 9,800, with 22 degrees of freedom, a 7 kg single-arm payload, an omnidirectional 3 m/s chassis and teleoperation latency under 10 ms.

item.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources Harness Agent Runtime With Everything-Is-a-Plugin Design
item.description: DeepSeek released DeepSeek Harness, an MIT-licensed agent runtime in developer preview where models, tools, sessions, sandboxes and UI are Cordis plugins, with npm packages advancing through the v0.1.5-rc line.

item.title: Pony.ai and GAC Unveil Gen-4 Level-4 Electric Robotruck at IAA 2026
item.description: At IAA Transportation 2026, Pony.ai and GAC Commercial Vehicle debuted a Gen-4 Level-4 electric heavy truck on the GAC T9 platform, aiming for volume production later in 2026 with a lower-cost automotive-grade ADK.
